scope: Ki Blast Super catalog — individually verified acquisition/stat completion

records.name: Wild Buster
records.effect: Rushes directly at the opponent; an additional input spends another 100 Ki to fire a Ki Wave.

records.name: Spirit Pulse
records.effect: Thrusts the fist forward and launches spirit energy.

records.name: Shooting Strike
records.unlock_method: Parallel Quest 156 - Hunting Down Dr. Hedo
records.effect: Fires a blaster beam and follows with a warp kick when it connects.

records.name: Blaster Bomb
records.unlock_method: Parallel Quest 148 - Finding Out About Fusion
records.effect: Launches a Ki Blast that splits into multiple projectiles after time passes or the opponent approaches.

records.name: Super Ghost Buu Attack
records.unlock_method: Parallel Quest 113 - Birth of the Ultimate Majin!
records.effect: Creates five ghosts that can be launched with a second input or left to attack automatically.

records.name: Petrifying Spit
records.unlock_method: Parallel Quest 114 - The Majin Revival Plan
records.effect: Spits a projectile that petrifies/paralyzes the opponent without dealing damage.

records.name: Power Impact
records.effect: A chargeable Ki Blast that, when fully charged, temporarily increases Ultimate Attack power.

records.name: Confusion Blade
records.effect: Creates suspended Ki spikes that track the opponent and can be shifted left or right.

records.name: Energy Minefield
records.effect: Places Ki mines that explode when an opponent approaches and briefly paralyze.

records.name: Candy Beam
records.unlock_method: Parallel Quest 113 - Birth of the Ultimate Majin!
records.effect: Turns the opponent into candy and reduces their Ki Blast skill damage; deals no direct damage.

records.name: Blaster Cannon
records.unlock_method: Parallel Quest 148 - Finding Out About Fusion
records.effect: Fires a barrage of eight Ki projectiles; closer range increases damage.

notes: CaC availability and Ultimate-Finish requirements remain null unless individually established. DLC labels are recorded only where the skill's documented character/DLC context establishes them.
